title: The dusty workshop
text: Your uncle's workshop is yours now: a bench, some sacks of stone, and a town that still remembers his floors. Start small. Black and white, the way he began.

title: Colour comes to town
text: Word is spreading. The marble merchant has started stopping at your door with coloured stone, and richer clients are asking for you: the baths, the taverns, the new money on the hill.

title: Pictures in stone
text: You've learned to cut tiles half the size, small enough for faces and feathers. The villas want picture panels now, and the council has noticed you.

title: Glass and gold
text: Glass from the east, and gold leaf sealed in glass. The temple of Venus is nearly built, and under the old forum, workmen have found something.
